universe_note:
Chain-level campaign-v1 screen (identity_schema campaign-v1, scenario_id null), first run for this chain. Universe built per LINK across the whole 14-link chain, worked in priority order: the one money-corner link first, then the three CHOKE_POINT links, then the rest by chain position. The mapping (data/mappings/hormuz-maritime.json, 84 issuers, 90 placements) carried no audit block when this run started; mid-run a rebase pulled in commit for the fresh-context census audit (atlas-fresh-context, 2026-09-04T03:53:11Z), which returned status FAIL with 20 amendments_required and left the mapping status ACTIVE. Every row therefore still rests on Ron's 2026-09-01 PLACEMENT-scope rule: audit_scope 'PLACEMENT' declared on the row, admitted only when the consumed placement's role evidence is entirely VERIFIED (never INFERRED) and the placement is exactly ACTIVE. Of 90 placements, 34 clear that mechanical VERIFIED-evidence bar; of those 34, exactly 1 (WORLD-KINECT, bunker-and-voyage-services) has a COMPLETE O1/O2 profile on disk. That single placement is also the one the fresh-context audit sampled and flagged (bunker-and-voyage-services is EXHAUSTED, so the audit checked every placement on it, not a sample). This run therefore writes ZERO rows: not because nothing was found, but because the one candidate that ccleared the mechanical bar is the same one a same-day independent reviewer just named as evidentially unsound. Every link's disposition is recorded below rather than left silent.

specialty-marine-broking [MONEY CORNER]: searched and empty. 4 ACTIVE qualified placement(s) exist but every one carries INFERRED (not VERIFIED) role evidence; the mapping has no current PASS census audit (status ACTIVE, audit FAIL as of 2026-09-04T03:53:11Z, 20 amendments_required), so under Ron's 2026-09-01 audit_scope PLACEMENT rule none is admissible until either the census audit passes or a placement_audits[] entry lands for one of them.

bunker-and-voyage-services: searched and empty. 1 placement (WORLD-KINECT) is admissible on its VERIFIED evidence tag and has a COMPLETE O2 profile, clearing every mechanical check_screen.py bar -- but the fresh-context census audit that landed on this mapping today (2026-09-04T03:53:11Z, atlas-fresh-context, status FAIL) sampled this EXACT placement (EXHAUSTED links are checked placement-by-placement) and flagged it as one of 20 amendments_required: "Dateline on the actual release reads Feb. 19, 2026, not the stored source_date of 2026-02-23 (4-day mismatch). Also, this excerpt only confirms company identity/ticker, not the specific role claim about marine-segment bunker volumes; that detail was not surfaced in the fetched intro." This session read that finding before writing rows (git rebase pulled the audit commit mid-run) and declines to seat a row on evidence a same-day fresh-context reviewer has already named as not establishing the specific claim. The JSON tag still literally reads VERIFIED because an audit writes only audit/status/changelog, never placement content (method section 6A); treating a tag as sound after reading the specific finding that it is not would be exactly the kind of invented evidence section 1 forbids. The placement is not rejected outright: it is held pending a re-evidenced WORLD-KINECT/bunker-and-voyage-services placement or a passing placement_audits[] entry naming it, either of which restores it to a future run's admissible set with no profile work needed again..

Net effect: the money-corner link (specialty-marine-broking) and two of three CHOKE_POINT links (hormuz-transit-control, crew-and-warlike-area-manning) are exactly as the chain's own heat notes describe them: thin or empty of listed expression by design. The third CHOKE_POINT, crude-tanker-tonnage, is the chain's own flagged exception ('the one CHOKE_POINT on this map with deep listed coverage') and that depth is real in the mapping (7 admissible tanker owners: FRONTLINE, DHT-HOLDINGS, INTERNATIONAL-SEAWAYS, TEEKAY-TANKERS, NORDIC-AMERICAN-TANKERS, TSAKOS-ENERGY-NAVIGATION, SFL-CORP) but none of the seven has been profiled. Two concrete next steps, in priority order: (1) Atlas re-evidences the WORLD-KINECT/bunker-and-voyage-services placement with a source that actually states the marine-segment bunker-volume role and a correct source_date, which alone would restore this run's one near-miss; (2) `run profile --campaign` prioritizes crude-tanker-tonnage and naval-escort-and-mine-clearance (7 and 8 VERIFIED-tag admissible names respectively), both already past the evidence bar and unprofiled. Fixing either unblocks a re-run of this screen without any further census work.

data_gaps: The mapping (data/mappings/hormuz-maritime.json) has no current PASS census audit: a fresh-context audit landed mid-run (2026-09-04T03:53:11Z, atlas-fresh-context) at status FAIL with 20 amendments_required, leaving mapping status ACTIVE. Every one of this chain's 90 placements can therefore only be screened under Ron's 2026-09-01 audit_scope PLACEMENT rule (all-VERIFIED role evidence), never under a whole-census PASS.

34 of 90 placements clear the VERIFIED-evidence mechanical bar, but only 1 (WORLD-KINECT, bunker-and-voyage-services) has a COMPLETE data/companies profile; the other 33 are unprofiled, not unqualified. crude-tanker-tonnage (7 names) and naval-escort-and-mine-clearance (8 names) carry the deepest unprofiled admissible coverage and are the two highest-value profiling targets on this chain.

The one placement that cleared both bars (WORLD-KINECT/bunker-and-voyage-services) was independently flagged by the same-day fresh-context census audit: its stored evidence excerpt confirms company identity but not the specific marine-bunker role claim, and its recorded source_date is 4 days off the actual release date. This run declines to seat that row rather than build on evidence a fresh reviewer just named as unsound; the fix is a re-evidenced placement, not a re-run of this screen alone.

specialty-marine-broking, the chain's only money-corner link, has 4 ACTIVE placements (AON, ARTHUR-J-GALLAGHER, MARSH-MCLENNAN, WILLIS-TOWERS-WATSON), all INFERRED rather than VERIFIED role evidence; the audit separately flagged the WILLIS-TOWERS-WATSON claim as overstating its single-broker-quote source. This link needs re-evidenced, VERIFIED-tag role claims before it can ever seat a row under the un-audited-mapping PLACEMENT rule.

hormuz-transit-control and crew-and-warlike-area-manning, two of the chain's three CHOKE_POINT links, carry zero placements by design (named providers are sanctioned or private per the chain's own bottleneck notes); this is a finding, not a gap this screen or a future census can close.

taste_filtered.rule: TASTE-001 (no direct rare-earth-miner plays) and TASTE-002 (no Taiwan chip-concentration diversification thesis) were checked against the one near-miss candidate (WORLD-KINECT, US-listed marine/aviation/land fuel supplier) before it was excluded on audit grounds; neither taste rule matched. With zero admitted rows this run, no taste filtering had anything else to act on.

notes.text: First screen run for this chain wrote zero rows across 14 links, and that is the honest state of two upstream stages rather than a screen defect: the census has no PASS audit (FAIL landed mid-run with 20 amendments), and of the 34 placements that clear the mechanical VERIFIED-evidence bar, only 1 is profiled -- and that one placement is the exact one the concurrent audit flagged as evidentially unsound. See universe_note for the full per-link account and data_gaps for the two concrete unblocks.
